summary: ChatRunDock and ChatRunMark: background runs that outlive their turn. The dock sits behind the composer's pill (bg-elevated, radius-lg, inset space-xl), one 32px row per run with a 14px StatusMatrix (Progress when measured, Working otherwise), name, truncating activity, a 40px tabular clock and a named Stop; the mark is the run's line in the thread — started, finished with an action, failed with Retry, or stopped. A named region, never a toast. The rows' matrices hold while the thread has a live edge (`isHeld`), and even when the thread is idle only the FIRST row moves — one live matrix per region, however many runs.
